newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Computer Power unable to confirm buyer.
newsitem.headline: Computer Power unable to confirm buyer.

text.p: Computer services group Computer Power Group Ltd said on Tuesday it had not yet been apprised of the identity of parties to two large trades in the company's shares late on Monday.
Two lines of 6.22 million shares were both specialled through First Pacific Stockbrokers at a price of A$3.85 per share after the market closed.
Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd held 6.22 million shares or about 18.6 percent of Computer Power's capital and brokers speculated the media giant had sold its stake.
"We have received no notification of the sale so we cannot confirm who the buyers or sellers were," a Computer power spokesman said.
Computer Power shares closed five cents lower at A$3.95 on Tuesday.
